title: Add PR preview builds
description: Builds a preview for every PR, including forks.
author: contributor-d

files_changed.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+name: PR preview
+
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: [opened, synchronize]
+
+permissions: write-all
+
+jobs:
+  preview:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+      - run: npm ci && npm run build:preview
+        env:
+          PREVIEW_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.PREVIEW_DEPLOY_KEY }}
